note: Rater-agreed pair verdicts (Fable 5.1 high + Opus 5 high, blind, same doctrine). Only pairs where both raters gave the same verdict. Acceptance: scorer preference (|delta|<0.02 = tie) agrees with verdict on >= 0.85 of these.

verdicts.fable_rationale: Both carry the same self-defeating NOT list; B adds two real forms (reward modeling, eval harness) that practitioners actually write.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B carries two real register forms practitioners write, 'reward modeling' and 'eval harness', at no noise cost.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A carries the evaluation register (evaluations, eval, evals) and reward modeling; same model-name anchor and same Gemini/Claude noise on both sides.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A spells the evaluation concept's real forms (evaluations, eval, evals) and reward modeling inside the gate group, tightening nothing and recovering real profiles.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A carries the evaluation concept's real forms (evaluation, evaluations, eval) that B omits; single-group, so no anchor penalty.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A completes the evaluation register (evaluation, evaluations, eval) beside the plural and colloquial forms already present.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B adds RL and reward modeling, both real forms of concepts already in the group.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B adds 'RL' and 'reward modeling', both forms people actually write for concepts already in the group.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A extends the environment family with tool calling, function calling, tool use and RL environment, all interrelated and pinned by the LLM-agents anchor.
verdicts.opus_rationale: Tool calling, function calling, tool use and RL environment are the same agent-infrastructure family and stay pinned by the LLM/agents anchor.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B carries the plural benchmarks and capability evaluation; A misses a form practitioners write constantly.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B adds the plural 'benchmarks' and 'capability evaluation', both literal forms the A side would miss.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B covers the sandbox/environment family far more exhaustively than A's three terms.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B covers the sandbox concept's real synonym set instead of three arbitrary members of it.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B adds VLM and multimodal LLM, real short forms of the vision-language concept already anchored in the group.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B adds 'VLM' and 'multimodal LLM', the acronym and colloquial form of a concept already named.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A carries the verb form fine-tuned and the Portuguese forms pré-treinamento and ajuste fino, all real surface forms.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A adds 'fine-tuned' plus the Portuguese forms of pretraining and fine-tuning, all real surfaces of concepts already present.

verdicts.opus_rationale: A adds the Portuguese phrasings of 'Portuguese LLM', which is how that population actually writes it.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B adds synthetic data pipeline and data generation pipeline, real phrases in the same synthetic-data family; slight generic risk on the latter is outweighed.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B carries the synthetic-data concept's other written forms (synthetic data pipeline, data generation pipeline) alongside the named methods.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B ORs the umbrella 'machine learning' into a specific group, making the whole string as broad as the umbrella.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B drops the umbrella 'machine learning' into a specific post-training group, making the whole group as broad as that term.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B puts 'machine learning' beside the model names, collapsing the anchor into an umbrella that matches everyone with an evaluation line.
verdicts.opus_rationale: 'machine learning' in the frontier-model anchor group dissolves the anchor into everyone in ML.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's 'machine learning' is an umbrella word that makes the evaluation group as broad as all of ML.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A's 'machine learning' is an umbrella OR'd into a tight evaluation group, admitting the whole field.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's 'machine learning' beside DeepMind and Gemini turns a targeted anchor into an umbrella.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's 'machine learning' beside DeepMind/Gemini destroys the org anchor's selectivity.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's 'machine learning' in the environment group makes the string match any ML person who mentions a language model.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's 'machine learning' beside the multimodal model names is an umbrella that swamps the specific group.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B puts spelled-out method names nobody writes into the DeepMind/Gemini anchor, breaking the anchor's class and adding nothing findable.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A is a bare model-name list that matches anyone who mentions Gemini or Claude in any sense; B's post-training gate pins it to the class.

verdicts.opus_rationale: The LLM/agents gate earns its AND by removing DevOps profiles that write 'containerized environments' or 'Docker' with no model work.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A has a dangling 'AND  NOT' and no post-training gate, so Whisper and VLM mentions alone match; B is well-formed and gated.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A is malformed, an AND with an empty operand before NOT, which loses outright.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's bare model list is full of tokens with louder Portuguese meanings (Tucano, Sabiá, Cabrita, Gervásio); B's training gate pins it to ML people.
verdicts.opus_rationale: Sabia, Cabrita, Tucano and Canarim are common Portuguese nouns; B's training-and-artifact gate is what keeps the search off birdwatchers.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A is the two-group ideal (RLHF family AND SFT/post-training family) with a short NOT; B has a dangling 'AND  NOT' and drops the second gate.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B is malformed, an AND with nothing on its right-hand side, and it also discards the SFT/post-training gate.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's second NOT repeats terms already excluded, a redundant clause that adds nothing and only risks parsing oddities.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B bolts on a second NOT clause that is wholly contained in the first, lengthening an already over-long exclusion list for no change in results.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's NOT (engineer OR researcher) excludes the very class being hired.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's NOT excludes 'engineer' and 'researcher', the very titles this role hires.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's NOT (engineer OR researcher) excludes the research engineers the search exists to find.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A's NOT throws out research engineers and researchers, the target class itself.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's NOT (engineer OR researcher) is self-harm against the hired class.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A's NOT removes the exact population being hired from an otherwise clean evaluation group.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B adds a NOT that excludes engineers and researchers, the target population.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's NOT on 'engineer' and 'researcher' is self-defeating against a research-engineer search.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's NOT (engineer OR researcher) removes the class being hired.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's trailing NOT excludes the class being hired and guts an otherwise well-built two-group string.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B AND-gates generic verbs (led, managed, owned), which excludes nobody useful and cuts recall arbitrarily.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B AND-gates the generic verbs led/managed/owned, which exclude nobody relevant and drop strong ICs who do not write that way.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B's generic-verb AND gate is doctrine's named anti-pattern.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's led/managed/owned gate is a generic-verb AND that filters on phrasing, not on capability.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's third gate of generic verbs over-constrains without pinning any class.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A adds a third gate of generic management verbs, over-constraining the string without excluding any wrong person.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A AND-gates led/managed/owned, generic verbs that exclude arbitrarily.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A AND-gates led/managed/owned onto an evaluation group, dropping hands-on candidates for a verb.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A's generic-verb gate is a third AND that excludes no class and drops good candidates.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A's third gate of generic verbs adds no exclusion power and skews toward managers.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B adds a generic-verb third gate that over-constrains an already well-anchored string.
verdicts.opus_rationale: B's led/managed/owned gate is a generic-verb AND on top of two already sufficient groups.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B extends the anchored model-name family with more named LLMs (Code Llama, DeepSeek-Coder, the Portuguese models); the Gervásio/Cabrita ambiguity is the same kind both sides already carry with Claude and Gemini, and the gate limits it.

verdicts.fable_rationale: A covers the training-framework family far more exhaustively, adding the post-training libraries (OpenRLHF, SkyRL, prime-rl, torchtune, LLaMA-Factory, DeepSpeed-Chat) most relevant to this role.
verdicts.opus_rationale: A covers the training-and-alignment framework family far more exhaustively, and the LLM group still anchors it.

verdicts.fable_rationale: B extends the benchmark family with six more real named benchmarks, and coverage is the measure for a named-specifics group.

verdicts.opus_rationale: B rounds out the training-stack family with the frameworks post-training engineers most often name, and the tokens stay specific.
